crossRefs.note: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord…
according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and…
Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come…

translations.web: Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.
translations.bsb: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
translations.kjv: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
translations.asv: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.
